title: Human Heart Nuclei Isolation for DroNc-seq
author: Stephanie Lozano
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vgue3ww

steps.title: Prepare buffers and chill
steps.instruction: Aliquot 20 mL EZ‑Prep Lysis Buffer and 7 mL NSB; place both tubes on ice while preparing tissue.

steps.title: Repeat step 5
steps.instruction: Repeat step 5 as described later in the protocol.

steps.title: Weigh tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 30–40 mg of heart tissue (yields usable nuclei); optionally mince with a scalpel or razor blade before douncing.

steps.title: Initial dounce with Pestle A
steps.instruction: Place tissue in a douncing mortar with 2 mL ice‑cold EZ‑Prep lysis buffer and dounce 25 strokes using Pestle A.

steps.title: Transfer, wash, and incubate
steps.instruction: Transfer the mortar contents to a 15 mL conical tube, wash the mortar with an additional 2 mL ice‑cold EZ‑Prep, and incubate the suspension on ice for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer mortar contents to 15 mL conical tube
Wash mortar with 2 mL ice‑cold EZ‑Prep

steps.title: Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Aspirate and wash with EZ‑Prep
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant, then wash and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL ice‑cold EZ‑Prep.

steps.title: Second dounce with Pestle B
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspension back to the douncing mortar and dounce 25 strokes using Pestle B.

steps.title: Repeat initial dounce and wash
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 4 (initial dounce with Pestle A) and 5 (transfer, wash, incubate) once more.

steps.title: Wash with 4 mL EZ‑Prep
steps.instruction: Wash and resuspend the pellet in 4 mL ice‑cold EZ‑Prep and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Reserve sample and assess nuclei
steps.instruction: Reserve a 10 µL aliquot for nuclei counting. If nuclei are insufficient, repeat steps 7‑9 (additional dounces with Pestle B) until an appropriate suspension is achieved (typically 25‑35 extra dounces). If membrane fragments remain, filter the suspension sequentially through a 20 µm filter then a 10 µm filter into fresh 50 mL conical tubes.

substeps.instruction: If needed, repeat steps 7‑9 (additional dounces with Pestle B)
If membrane fragments persist, filter sequentially through 20 µm then 10 µm filters into fresh 50 mL tubes

steps.title: Wash with NSB (4 mL)
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant, then wash and resuspend the pellet in 4 mL ice‑cold NSB.

steps.title: Repeat transfer, wash, incubate
steps.instruction: Repeat step 5 (transfer to tube, wash with 2 mL ice‑cold EZ‑Prep, incubate 5 min).

steps.title: Final NSB resuspension
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL ice‑cold NSB.

steps.title: Filter nuclei (10 µm)
steps.instruction: Filter the nuclei suspension through a 10 µm filter into a fresh 50 mL conical tube and keep on ice until use.

steps.title: Count nuclei with DAPI/WGA
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL nuclei with 10 µL DAPI and 10 µL WGA in a microcentrifuge tube, load 10 µL into a hemocytometer, and count using overlaid fluorescent and phase‑contrast images.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µL nuclei, 10 µL DAPI, and 10 µL WGA
Count nuclei using fluorescent and phase‑contrast imaging

steps.title: Dilute nuclei to target concentration
steps.instruction: After counting, dilute the nuclei with the remaining NSB to the desired concentration; typical yield is 300–400 k nuclei per mL of final suspension.
